Subassembly.Name: ImportedPolylineSubassemblies
Subassembly.Description: Imports polyline geometry from a CSV file
Subassembly.Author: Bimorph Consultancy

Parameter.Name: CsvPath
Parameter.Description: Path to the CSV file containing offset,elevation pairs

Parameter.Name: PointCode
Parameter.Description: Code to assign to all points

Parameter.Name: LinkCode
Parameter.Description: Code to assign to all links

Parameter.Name: Closed
Parameter.Description: Set to 1 to close the shape
